# Azizbek Safarov: open competition headquarters

- [Start here](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/ai.md): central context and four curated designs.
- [Yuksal starter](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/design/si/ai.md): editorial motion website.
- [Bloom M3 starter](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/design/bloom/ai.md): functional project workspace.
- [Samar starter](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/design/samar/ai.md): itinerary and verified destination sources.
- [Forma starter](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/design/forma/ai.md): concept catalog and cart.
- [Competition brief](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/design/handoff/competition.md): dated evidence and uncertain rules.
- [Full research](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/ustoz/ai.md): collected local and official-web information.
- [Quality standard](https://azizbeksafarov.github.io/design/DESIGN-STANDARD.md).

The user’s actual ticket and current instructions take priority. These resources do not guarantee autonomous execution or correctness.
